answers.core: Addons can't modify the way Godot's C# attributes work.
answers.workaround: It can be worked around with very many lines of script and the tedium of making sure to wrap any code you don't want to run in the editor around `if (!Engine.EditorHint)`.

title: In C#, add an additional parameter to `[Export]` to customize the exported property's name on the property list.
